target.title: fix(nvidia): use Nemotron Super 1M context
target.body:
## Summary

Correct the bundled NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super metadata so OpenClaw's fallback catalog uses the model card's documented 1,000,000-token context window.

## Changes

- Update the bundled Nemotron 3 Super context window from 262,144 to 1,000,000 tokens.
- Leave NVIDIA's public featured-model feed values unchanged and authoritative.
- Align the bundled fallback documentation and focused provider test.

## Validation

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/nvidia` passed.
- Targeted oxfmt and oxlint checks passed.
- NVIDIA docs MDX and link checks passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Fresh tracked-diff autoreview reported no accepted/actionable findings (0.94 confidence).
- Live feed inspection confirmed the current featured row still reports 262,144 tokens and is not rewritten by this change.

## Notes

- NVIDIA can correct the public featured-model feed at its source; authenticated live-catalog consumers will receive that value without OpenClaw normalization.
- Existing explicit model overrides and `agents.defaults.contextTokens` caps remain authoritative.
- No config schema, CLI, gateway protocol, or Plugin SDK contract changes.
- AI-assisted; I reviewed the implementation and validation results.

## What Problem This Solves

The bundled fallback catalog advertised 262,144 tokens for Nemotron 3 Super even though NVIDIA's model card specifies a 1,000,000-token context window. Users relying on the bundled fallback could therefore compact earlier than necessary.

## Why This Change Was Made

The bundled metadata should match the NVIDIA model card. The separate public featured-model feed remains provider-owned and passes through unchanged, avoiding duplicate correction policy in OpenClaw.

## User Impact

Users of the bundled NVIDIA fallback catalog receive the intended 1,000,000-token context budget. Users receiving the live featured catalog will pick up its corrected value when NVIDIA updates the feed.

## Evidence

- NVIDIA's hosted model card reports `context: 1000000` for Nemotron 3 Super.
- A focused provider test proves the bundled fallback exposes a 1,000,000-token context window.
- Existing live-catalog tests pass with the provider-owned feed path unchanged.
